episodes.synopsis: The Witch of the Lake, Rose, falls for a knight, who later visits her seeking a love potion.
episodes.title: The Witch and the Love Potion of Unrequited Love

episodes.synopsis: Rose finds herself being conscious of her looks while Harij begins to wonder about her disheveled lifestyle.
episodes.title: The Good Witch of the Lake

episodes.synopsis: With every visit, Harij helps Rose realize things she's overlooked before. Even of a certain song she sings.
episodes.title: The Black Tea Scented Witch's Song

episodes.synopsis: Harij continues to feel pressured to accomplish his mission, though something inside himself begins to change.
episodes.title: A Knight's Duty Even Unknown to the Witch

episodes.synopsis: As time passes, Rose begins to realize the impact Harij is having on her life. However, to live as a witch...
episodes.title: To Be a Witch

episodes.synopsis: With the potion complete, Rose explains to Harij how to use it, when he makes a shocking request to test it.
episodes.title: The Witch and the Promised Love Potion

episodes.synopsis: With only one month before her wedding, Billaura took Harij's word to heart and decided to make a bold move.
episodes.title: The One to Cast a Spell on the Princess Is a Witch

episodes.synopsis: Finding it hard to believe that Rose ever gets to rest, Harij takes it upon himself to make sure she sleeps.
episodes.title: Witch of the Sleeping Forest
